text: This solution, Probabilistic Tsunami Hazard Assessment for Vanimo Port Design (PTHA–Vanimo) addresses natural catastrophe in Papua New Guinea between PNG Department of Transport, PNG maritime/port authorities, Geoscience Australia, and NOAA Center for Tsunami Research. The program was implemented in 2024-2026 and focuses on collaboration and leveraging tech.
